name: CF7 WOW Styler – Visual Design Styler for Contact Form 7 Forms
author: Saleswonder Team: Tobias

sections.description:
CF7 WOW Styler helps you style your Contact Form 7 forms visually, without writing CSS. You design directly in the browser, see every change in the live preview, and apply the style with one click.

Use CF7 WOW Styler to adjust colors, spacing, buttons, backgrounds (including animated backgrounds), lists, labels, and error messages. The free version is ideal if you want to style one important form, for example your main contact or request form.

🎥 First look at CF7 WOW Styler (1:18)
Short demo showing how a standard Contact Form 7 form becomes a styled WOW form.

Why Choose CF7 WOW Styler?

CF7 WOW Styler was built for users who already use Contact Form 7 and want to style and design their forms without CSS knowledge. You can start from a default template or create a new design with many style settings, then reuse that style and adapt it for other forms.

With live preview you can adjust your form design and see changes immediately. The split view lets you compare the published version with the style in progress.

The plugin works with common themes, page builders, and modern browsers. It uses your theme’s fonts and base colors as a starting point, so you only need to change what is really important.

One Styled Form vs. Many Forms

The free version focuses on one fully styled form. For many sites, this is enough:

  • One main “Contact us” form
  • A single inquiry or booking form
  • A simple support form that collects all requests in one inbox

The Pro version is for sites that need multiple forms with different purposes and designs, for example:

  • WooCommerce shops

    • Returns and refunds
    • Product complaints or damaged items
    • Invoice and payment questions
    • Feature or product requests

  • Agencies and service providers

    • New client requests
    • Existing client support
    • Project briefing and onboarding
    • Partner or affiliate applications

  • SaaS and online courses

    • Demo requests
    • Bug reports or technical support
    • Feature ideas and roadmap feedback

Instead of one long form with a big “department / topic” dropdown and complex conditions, you can use separate forms:

  • Each department has its own form with its own questions
  • Each form can send directly to the right team email
  • Each form can have its own styling and tone (sales vs. support vs. feedback)

This can be easier to maintain and more productive for teams than one “all‑in‑one” form.

How CF7 WOW Styler Fits into a Bigger Flow

Forms are ideal when visitors need a direct answer, for example:

  • Returns and refund requests
  • Support and technical issues
  • Order or invoice questions
  • Concrete feature requests

If someone wants general information or an overview of your solution, a webinar can be a good next step. Repeated beginner questions can be covered once in a webinar and reused as evergreen content.

CF7 WOW Styler helps you present forms clearly and attractively. From there, you can:

  • Send form data to WP2LEADS and into your email marketing or CRM
  • Invite interested contacts into automated or live webinars using WebinarIgnition

From Styled Forms to a Webinar Funnel

When your forms generate regular leads, a webinar funnel is often the next logical step:

  • Forms collect contact details and topics
  • Webinars show your offer in a structured way and can lead directly to sales

Recommended additions:

  • WebinarIgnition – Live & Automated Webinars for WooCommerce:
    https://wordpress.org/plugins/webinar-ignition/

  • Article: “From Contact Form to Automated Webinar Funnel – The Smart Path for WordPress Sites”:
    https://webinarignition.com/from-contact-form-to-automated-webinar-funnel-the-smart-path-for-wordpress-sites/

CF7 WOW Styler sorgt für hochwertige Formulare, WebinarIgnition übernimmt den nächsten Schritt: aus Anfragen werden strukturierte Webinar‑Präsentationen mit Verkaufschancen.

If you also use WP2LEADS, you can route form data into your email tool, build segments, and start automated follow‑ups based on answers in the form.

How to Get Started with WOW Styler Free

Getting started with WOW Styler takes just a few steps:

  • In your WordPress admin, go to “Plugins” → “Add New”
  • Search for “cf7 styler” or “wow styler”
  • Install and activate “CF7 WOW Styler”
  • Go to “Contact” → “CF7 Styler”
  • Select one of your Contact Form 7 forms and start styling in the live preview

CF7 WOW Styler Free Features

The free version lets you fully style one Contact Form 7 form.

You can:

  • Customize text styles (colors, sizes, basic font families)
  • Set link and hover colors
  • Style labels (color, size, basic font options)
  • Control form padding, margins, and borders
  • Style input fields (text color, background, spacing, borders, radius)
  • Customize buttons (text, background, hover, shadows, borders)
  • Use simple background colors
  • Preview your style before applying it
  • Use split view (published vs. in progress)
  • Use a second column view (styled vs. unstyled)
  • Apply a default style scheme to all forms
  • Add custom CSS for advanced use cases

CF7 WOW Styler Pro Features

The Pro version includes all free features plus:

  • Individual style schemes for multiple forms
  • Attach different styles to different Contact Form 7 forms
  • Animated GIF and image backgrounds with opacity control
  • Additional background options (size, repeat, position)
  • “One per line” layout for checkboxes and radio buttons
  • Load styles via inline tags if a theme or page builder strips header CSS

Pro is designed for websites with several forms and different processes (shop, support, sales, feedback) that each need their own design.

Quick Use Cases of the Free Version

With the free version you can:

  • Change colors (text, background, hover) to match your brand
  • Adjust only background or button styling and save different schemes
  • Highlight submit buttons with stronger contrast and hover effects
  • Make a default Contact Form 7 form look integrated into your theme

Brilliant Use Cases of the WOW Styler Pro

With Pro you can:

  • Give each form its own style (for example sales form vs. support form)
  • Place several differently styled forms on one page
  • Use animated backgrounds for special campaigns
  • Keep form styles even when a page builder removes header CSS by loading styles via inline tags

This is useful for WooCommerce shops, agencies, and SaaS providers with multiple teams and responsibilities.

How to Switch to the Pro Version

If you have an active WP2LEADS Pro license (WordPress to email‑marketing / CRM bridge), you can use WOW Styler Premium features as part of that setup.

You can also start a trial from inside the plugin and test all Pro settings before you decide.

Basic steps:

  • Go to “Contact” → “CF7 Styler”
  • Open the “Upgrade” area
  • Choose the Pro package that fits your usage
  • Complete the purchase inside the plugin
  • Your license activates automatically, and you receive an email with your license key and invoice

sections.faq:
Here are some frequently asked questions about the WOW Styler plugin:

Can I test the Pro features in a free trial period?

Yes. You can enable a Pro trial inside the plugin and test all Pro features for a limited time. You will receive an email notification before the trial ends so you can decide whether to continue with a paid plan.

Who needs more than one styled form on a site?

Shops, agencies, and SaaS providers often benefit from multiple forms:

  • Shops: separate forms for returns, support, invoice questions, feature requests
  • Agencies: new client intake, existing client support, project onboarding
  • SaaS: demo requests, bug reports, feature ideas

Each team can have its own form with its own questions and mail recipient, instead of maintaining one large conditional form.

How does this work with WP2LEADS?

WP2LEADS can collect data from your CF7 WOW Styler forms and send it to email marketing tools or CRMs. This is useful if you want to:

  • Build segmented lists based on form answers
  • Start automations in your email tool
  • Track which forms and campaigns generate which leads

How does this connect to webinars and WebinarIgnition?

CF7 WOW Styler helps you create clear, attractive forms. You can then:

  • Send form data to your email tool or CRM via WP2LEADS
  • Invite these contacts to automated or live webinars with WebinarIgnition

Use forms when visitors need direct, specific answers (return, support, invoice). Use webinars when many people have similar questions or need a guided explanation of your product.

Can I propose a plugin customization?

Yes. We welcome suggestions. Please describe your use case in the support forum. A short screen recording without personal data can help us understand your request faster.

Do you have an affiliate program?

Yes. You can find details and your affiliate link inside the plugin under the “Affiliation” section.

How can I translate the plugin?

You can use the Loco Translate plugin to create .po and .mo files. Afterwards, you can send updated translations to support@saleswonder.biz.

How can I report security bugs?

You can report security issues through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. Patchstack helps validate, triage, and coordinate fixes.
